  "rule": "Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and, in the text field, an original fictional passage of about 250 words that comes immediately BEFORE the current text in the same invented story.",
  "text": "On Monday, Mara arrived with two suitcases and a bag of bread rolls gone hard on the train. Bristle heard her at the front door and began barking from somewhere inside. She tried the larger key first. By the time she found the smaller one, he had stopped barking and was pressing his nose against the letterbox.

Her mother had left a note on the kitchen table. It listed the days for putting out the bins, the number of the plumber and the place where Bristle’s lead was kept. There was no date on it. Mara folded the paper and slipped it into the drawer with the takeaway menus.

She had taken the week off to clear the house. On Tuesday, she filled a box with spare bedding and another with the tins her mother had bought in pairs. Bristle followed her from room to room, settling each time just as she was ready to leave. When she opened the back door, he ran as far as the shed, then stood there looking at her.

On Wednesday, Mara drove to the charity shop with the boxes. She returned with an empty car and found a message from the letting agent about her flat. He wanted a day when someone could collect the keys. She called back, but reached his voicemail.

That evening she walked Bristle along the lane. Coming home, she noticed the nettles had grown across the narrow path behind the shed. Her mother had always kept it clear. Mara fetched a pair of gardening gloves from the porch and left them by the back door."
